blocks.text: Ammonia Lowry-Brønsted base ki tarah kaam karti hai: yeh acid se ek proton (H⁺) le kar (accept kar ke) ammonium banati hai:
Ammonia pani mein hal ho kar ammonium hydroxide (NH₄OH) banati hai, aur solution mein ammonia molecules aur ammonium ions ke darmiyan equilibrium qaim ho jata hai.
Ammonia ka solution weak (kamzor) base hai, kyun ke is ka basicity constant (Kb) chhota hai aur equilibrium bohat baen (left) taraf hai, yani zyada tar NH₃ molecules hi rehte hain.

blocks.title: Basicity constant Kb
blocks.text: Pani mein ammonia ke liye Kb = [NH₄⁺][OH⁻] / [NH₃] = 1.8×10⁻⁵. Chhoti qeemat ka matlab hai ke hal shuda ammonia ka sirf thora sa hissa NH₄⁺ aur OH⁻ ions mein badalta hai.

blocks.prompt: Ammonia weak base kyun hai (exercise Q.2c)?
blocks.explanation: Pani mein ammonia sirf thore protons leti hai: NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ ka equilibrium bohat baen taraf hai aur Kb sirf 1.8×10⁻⁵ hai. Is liye OH⁻ ions ki concentration kam rehti hai, NaOH jaise strong base ke muqable mein jo poora ionise ho jata hai.

items: NH₃ acid se H⁺ le kar NH₄⁺ banati hai: Lowry-Brønsted base.
Pani mein NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻, Kb = 1.8×10⁻⁵; equilibrium baen taraf, is liye weak base.
